task.title: P6-170: Fold three e2e authoring traps into the e2e-suite skill
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 9 — Dev loop, tests and test strength). Original id: P6-170. Size: S. Specs: specs/ui-work-loop.md.

**Fold three e2e authoring traps into the `e2e-suite` skill in one commit** (was `P6-004` + `P6-040b` + `P6-077`; all three verified 2026-07-30 as still missing from the skill). (1) **A stale read from the watch server is indistinguishable from a passing test** — rebuilds take minutes, and a mutation that has not compiled yet looks exactly like a mutation the test survived; poll on a marker in the served HTML, never on elapsed time (currently only in `app-ui.md:1157-1160` prose). (2) **`cargo leptos watch` silently drops a save that lands mid-rebuild**, and `touch` does not retrigger it (it appears to hash content) — only a genuinely different content change forces the rebuild. (3) **The e2e `tr_jwt` cookie expires in ~20 minutes**, and the symptom is the page rendering `Couldn't load this collection: unauthorized: invalid token`, which reads like a page bug and has cost two separate debug cycles; `npx playwright test --project=setup` refreshes it. The skill names the cookie at `:77` but not its expiry, symptom or fix.
